notes: Verified against both the catalog course page and the department major page. Total: 56 units (14 four-unit courses) — 2 lower-division (8 units) and 12 upper-division (48 units). All courses must be taken for a letter grade with a minimum 2.0 GPA. Maximum three upper-division courses may be taken in any single department. Maximum two courses (8 units) may overlap between major and minor. Study-abroad/unlisted courses require petition.

buckets.label: Lower-division foundation course
buckets.note: One of: CLX 1 (Cornerstone of Chicanx and Latinx Studies) OR ETHN 30 (Introduction to Chicanx and Latinx Studies). Verified on both pages.

buckets.label: Additional lower-division course
buckets.note: Choose one of the listed courses, or a petition-approved course from another department/university. Verified on major page (CLX 2, CLX 3, HILD 7C).

buckets.label: Upper-division research/core course
buckets.note: One of: CLX 101 (Approaches to Research in Chicanx and Latinx Studies) OR AAS 170 (Legacies of Research on Disenfranchised Communities). Verified on major page.

buckets.label: Research Practicum (required core)
buckets.note: CLX 102: Research Practicum in Chicanx and Latinx Studies. Verified on both pages.

buckets.label: Capstone (required core)
buckets.note: CLX 103: Capstone of Chicanx and Latinx Studies. Verified on both pages.

buckets.label: Upper-division electives
buckets.note: Nine upper-division courses selected from the approved Chicanx and Latinx Studies course offerings list (drawn from CLX and 100+ cross-listed courses across multiple departments). Maximum three from any single department. Count verified (9 electives = 12 upper-div total minus 3 core).
